title: How To Create A Newsletter Template | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Create A Newsletter Template Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000004623 This article explains how to create a newsletter template from the Emails >> Send Newsletter section of the admin area. Newsletter templates can also be created from Emails >> Email Templates , but this article focuses on creating one directly from the newsletter builder. Where to Start Go to Emails >> Send Newsletter . Click the New Email Newsletter button. The first step is to give the newsletter a name and choose how the newsletter should be created. There are three available options: Start Blank AI Generate Select Template Option 1: Start Blank Selecting Start Blank opens the standard newsletter editor. This option is best when the newsletter will be created manually from scratch. Enter a name for the newsletter. Select Start Blank . Click Continue . The admin will be taken to the newsletter editor, where the newsletter content can be added, edited, saved, and sent. Option 2: AI Generate Selecting AI Generate opens the Quick Create Wizard, which helps generate a newsletter using AI. This option is useful when the admin wants help creating the first draft of the newsletter content. For complete step-by-step instructions, please see the following article: Quick Create Wizard - Create Newsletter The Quick Create Wizard allows the admin to: Add a custom prompt for the newsletter Select options for format, tone, audience, length, images, and color mood Use suggested prompts as a starting point Review and edit the generated newsletter before saving Continue to the standard newsletter editor to make final changes or send the newsletter Option 3: Select Template Selecting Select Template allows the admin to create a newsletter from an existing saved newsletter template. This option is best when the site already has newsletter templates saved and one of those templates should be reused. Enter a name for the newsletter. Select Select Template . Choose one of the available saved newsletter templates. Click Continue . The selected template will open in the standard newsletter editor, where the content can be edited and sent.
